## Notes
- I assumed no brand suffix (you didn’t provide a brand). If your brand has search demand, add it as a short suffix (e.g., "…Picks | Brand") only if space allows.
- What would lift CTR further: A/B test one element for ~4 weeks — either (A) include the year (e.g., “(2026)”) for freshness or (B) lead with a specific differentiator in the title (e.g., “9 Space‑Saving Picks — Best Under $300”). The current pair is optimized for clarity and pixel fit.
- To avoid mobile truncation of the description, you can either shorten it by ~35 characters (or ~170px) or move the strongest call-to-action/value into the first 100 characters (e.g., start with “Under $300 — find compact, adjustable standing desks for small apartments…”) so mobile users see the key benefit.
